third_party_evaluations.summary: Professional-tier AWS architecture covering secure multi-account, encryption, and resilient design.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Secure multi-account architecture, encryption and resilience support professional design responsibility in the recorded evidence; vendor specificity and a two-year profile fall short of cross-domain expert standing.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The stored multi-account, encryption and resilient-design scope supports professional ownership of AWS architecture. Proctoring and the NICCS hint add confidence, while the two-year profile and no recorded practical examination fall short of expert assurance.

alex-novak.rationale: Secure multi-account architecture and encryption are useful consulting knowledge, but the recorded two-year profile and unspecified practical assessment limit the demonstrated level. I therefore discount the Professional title to associate.
